data.name: Ripple Lane 101 : Moments With You
data.detailed_description:
Yi Ling — a girl from New Shanghai, 2146 — just moved into her dorm at the Jiutian Interstellar Navigation Academy. A whole university life is waiting for her, and it's going to be anything but boring.

You'll be her companion. Spend lazy afternoons together, or maybe late nights when she's buried in coursework. Listen to her stories about life on a futuristic campus. Get to know her, her friends, and the world she lives in.

She's growing — she just doesn't realize it yet. As time goes by, new conversations appear and new chapters unfold. You don't need to do anything special. Just be here, and give her your time.

Idle Progression

Experience builds while the game runs. Keep it on a second monitor, get your own work done — check back once in a while, and there might be a new conversation waiting.

Pomodoro Timer & Goal Tracking

A pomodoro timer breaks your day into focused sessions. To-do lists and habit tracking keep your plans on track. Yi Ling's busy with her own things while you focus, too.

Ambient Sound & Lofi

Rain, keyboard clicks, café chatter… layer your own mix of background sounds. Pair it with lofi music and slip into flow whenever you want.

Story Conversations

At certain milestones, new conversations unlock. Some are about classes, some about the stars, some… she seems like she wants to say something, then holds back. Where the story goes — you'll have to see for yourself.

Collectible outfits, room decorations and more are in development. Stay tuned.

data.short_description: Spend your days with Yi Ling in her laid-back campus dorm. Focus with a pomodoro timer, mix some white noise, tune into a lofi station, and unlock fun campus stories along the way — the time you spend here quietly becomes her story.
data.supported_languages:
English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese*, Korean, Traditional Chinese*
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB or better (DirectX 12 support required)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit processor and operating system required. SSD recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700 / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit processor and operating system required.
